scope: Backend-authoritative Direct aggregate status and report presentation; no engineering freeze
added_steps:
- name: Generate authenticated Direct F9 status and report matrix
        run: python ../scripts/generate_direct_f9_ci_pdfs.py --output direct-f9-review-pdfs
      - name: Upload Direct F9 status and report evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-f9-pdfs-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: backend/direct-f9-review-pdfs/
          if-no-files-found: error

backend_timeout_minutes.reason: Retain every historical gate and add twelve real F9 PDFs on each operating system

dependencies: F8-G1 hash-locked pins and all security audit requirements unchanged
protected_refs: main and all three protected annotated tags unchanged
